description: This file is a JSON schema defining the interface for the System API of a device management system, specifying methods, events, data types, and documentation for system-level features.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device details such as MAC addresses, build type, and firmware version.

methods.name: getDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the status and location of firmware downloads.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Retrieves current firmware download progress percentage.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateInfo
methods.description: Checks the firmware update information asynchronously.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateState
methods.description: Checks the current state of the firmware update process.

methods.name: getLastFirmwareFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the last firmware update failure.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the last wakeup key code.

methods.name: getMacAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves various MAC addresses of the device.

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturing serial number of the device.

methods.name: getNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Returns whether network standby mode is supported.

methods.name: getPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Provides supported features and device/account info.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Returns the current power state of the device.

methods.name: getPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Returns the power state prior to reboot.

methods.name: getRFCConfig
methods.description: Retrieves RDK Feature Control configurations.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the device serial number.

methods.name: getSystemVersions
methods.description: Returns system version details.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Returns the current friendly name of the device.

methods.name: getTerritory
methods.description: Gets system territory and region settings.

methods.name: getTimeZones
methods.description: Retrieves available system time zones.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Gets the current time zone and DST information.

methods.name: getWakeupReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for device wakeup from deep sleep.

methods.name: isOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks if telemetry is opted out.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Requests a system reboot.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Returns the device uptime.

methods.name: setDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets deep sleep timeout.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-reboot after firmware updates.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets system operation mode for a duration.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby mode.

methods.name: setOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets telemetry opt-out status.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the device power state.

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Sets a new friendly name for the device.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Configures the boot loader splash screen.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns the build type of the flashed image.

methods.name: setTerritory
methods.description: Sets system territory and region.

methods.name: setTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Sets the system time zone and DST settings.

methods.name: setWakeupSrcConfiguration
methods.description: Configures wakeup sources; deprecated in favor of setWakeupSrcConfiguration.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Initiates firmware update process.

methods.name: uploadLogsAsync
methods.description: Starts logs upload in background.

methods.name: abortLogUpload
methods.description: Stops background logs upload.
